justification: Adds the five scripts the dcp-commit and outreach jobs reach but the monitors image never copied; adds a test that walks imports and subprocess paths from every worker

break_it.scenario: a worker runs a sibling script as a subprocess instead of importing it
break_it.what_happens: the old scan saw only 'from scripts.X import', so the file was left out and dcp-commit exited 1 every day from 2026-10-30
break_it.how: test_everything_a_worker_reaches_is_copied follows subprocess script paths built from the scripts folder, and bare lazy imports, transitively
break_it.repro: remove 'COPY scripts/council_quote.py' and run pytest tests/test_dockerfile_monitors_imports.py

break_it.scenario: the import form changes so the walk finds nothing and passes vacuously
break_it.what_happens: the test would pass with every gap open
break_it.how: asserts the walk reached more modules than the worker list itself
break_it.repro: replace the import regex with one that matches nothing and run the test: the 'walk found no siblings' assertion fails

break_it.scenario: an import of a module with the same name as a scripts/ file but meant from pip
break_it.what_happens: the test asks for a COPY that is not needed
break_it.how: a false demand fails loudly in CI, never silently in production; add the COPY or rename

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — after Railway rebuilds dcp-commit, start one run and confirm the log has no 'can't open file' and exits 0

falsifiable_check.fails_when: any script a monitor worker imports or runs as a subprocess has no COPY line in Dockerfile.monitors
falsifiable_check.observed_red: with Dockerfile.monitors reverted: test_everything_a_worker_reaches_is_copied failed listing dcp_commit_approved reaches council_quote, council_quote reaches council_quote_db, council_quote_picture, council_quote_table, outreach_claim_checks reaches conveyancing_db

pre_impl.existing_data: Railway dcp-commit logs 2026-10-30 to 2026-11-02: four runs, each 'can't open file /app/scripts/council_quote.py', exit 1
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: the existing image test only matched 'from scripts.X import', so subprocess calls and bare lazy imports were invisible to it
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: extends the existing test file and the existing COPY list; no new image or new script

functions.name: test_everything_a_worker_reaches_is_copied
functions.input: Dockerfile.monitors text plus the source of every scripts/ module reachable from the worker list
functions.output: assertion failure naming each reached module with no COPY line
functions.if_none: a module that does not exist under scripts/ is skipped, so stdlib and pip imports never count
